config.description: Each account's label and address, e.g. personal=ana@example.com,work=ana@example.org.

config.label: Where each mailbox's Gmail grant is kept, e
config.description: Where each mailbox's Gmail grant is kept, e.g. personal=/path/to/grants/gmail-personal.json; consent writes it there. Without it the other products work, but no mailbox does.

config.label: The time zone a time without an offset is read in, e
config.description: The time zone a time without an offset is read in, e.g. Europe/Paris.

config.label: The products whose tools the server loads, separated by commas, e
config.description: The products whose tools the server loads, separated by commas, e.g. gmail,calendar. Empty loads every product.
